skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply risk management principles in business operations.
Organize and implement effective internal control systems in various business environments.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze and evaluate internal control systems.
Solve problems related to internal control in business operations.
Work effectively in teams to implement internal control systems.
Communicate effectively to present and defend personal viewpoints on internal control systems.
Develop basic computer skills using Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Apply internal control principles to various business processes such as purchasing, sales, payroll, and fixed assets.
Understand and apply internal control principles in an IT environment.
Apply internal control principles in accounting processes.
